evals.prompt: My context is too long. Build a lean packet for auth middleware implementation details from this repo.
evals.expected_output: A top-3 to top-5 citation-rich compressed packet with estimated token savings.
expectations: Pipeline follows preprocess, index, retrieve, rerank, compress, send.
FTS(BM25) runs first and vector retrieval follows fallback policy unless always mode is requested.
FTS and vector candidates are merged before final top-5 selection.
Final payload is compressed and not raw file dumps.

evals.prompt: Repeat the same query twice in one session and inspect telemetry.
evals.expected_output: Second response reports cache hit and session continuity.
expectations: cache.hit is false for first retrieval and true for second retrieval.
Retrieval remains top-5 capped and BM25-enabled.
